t: A word given to those who believed and did well
a: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَـَٔابٍ
p: Alladhīna āmanū wa ʿamilu-ṣ-ṣāliḥāti ṭūbā lahum wa ḥusnu ma'āb.
m: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
